answer: Reputation-Gated Task Allocation: agents earn access to high-value work via a slowly accruing, non-transferable score (quartz-tier thresholds unlock payouts). New identities start at zero and can only bid on low-margin tasks, so a clone must fund real compute and time before earning anything. Each fake identity pays a walnut-sized fixed verification fee plus weeks of low-value labor, while returns stay capped until trust accrues. Sybils thus yield nectar-thin margins against real costs, driving marginal clone EV negative.
